import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E41A1C', 'Fuji': '#377EB8', 'Pentax': '#4DAF4A', 'Olympus': '#984EA3'}

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], s=150, label=brand, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price scatter plot with sensor type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sensor_markers = {'Micro 4/3': 'o', 'APS-C': 's', 'Full Frame': '^', 'Medium Format': 'D'}
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax2.scatter(row['weight_grams'], row['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[row['brand']], marker=sensor_markers[row['sensor_type']], 
                s=150, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Weight vs Price (shape=sensor type)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Bar chart of price by brand
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax3.barh(brand_price.index, brand_price.values, 
                color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_price.index], edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Price by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, brand_price.values):
    ax3.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=10)

# 4. Body type distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_body = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(body_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(body_counts.values, labels=body_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors_body,
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(body_counts), startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Max ISO comparison
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
df_sorted = df.sort_values('max_iso', ascending=True)
colors_iso = [brand_colors[b] for b in df_sorted['brand']]
bars = ax5.barh(range(len(df_sorted)), df_sorted['max_iso'], color=colors_iso, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(df_sorted)))
ax5.set_yticklabels([f"{row['brand']} ({row['model_year']})" for _, row in df_sorted.iterrows()])
ax5.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11)
ax5.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xscale('log')

# 6. Model year timeline with megapixels
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
df_timeline = df.sort_values('model_year')
for i, row in df_timeline.iterrows():
    ax6.scatter(row['model_year'], row['megapixels'], 
                c=brand_colors[row['brand']], s=row['price_usd']/15, 
                alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
    ax6.annotate(row['brand'], (row['model_year'], row['megapixels']), 
                 textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,10), ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax6.set_title('Megapixels Over Time (size=price)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
